summary.text: Antonio "Tone" Felipe represents Connecticut's 130th House District (Bridgeport) and is serving his fourth term.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Bridgeport, he is described on the page as the first Dominican American elected to the Connecticut House of Representatives.
He was appointed a Deputy Majority Leader in 2020 and chairs the Connecticut Black and Puerto Rican Caucus.
He works at the University of Bridgeport as Manager of Community Partnership.
